target_beneficiaries: Eligible rural houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses
objective: To provide pucca houses with basic amenities to eligible rural households
house_size: Minimum 25 sq. metres including hygienic cooking space
additional_support: Toilet assistance through convergence with SBM-G/MGNREGA or other sources
Convergence for drinking water, electricity and LPG connections
beneficiary_selection: Eligible households are identified using prescribed deprivation/exclusion criteria and official beneficiary lists.
monitoring: Implemented and monitored through e-Governance systems including AwaasSoft and Awaas App.
payment_mode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's registered bank/post-office account
source: Official PMAY-G, Department of Rural Development, Government of India
